mapper.update: INSERT INTO ledger_entry( tenant_id, id, entry_type, business_time, business_date, product_id, product_name_snapshot, primary_category_id, primary_category_name_snapshot, secondary_category_id, secondary_category_name_snapshot, unit_id, unit_name_snapshot, unit_price, quantity, calculated_amount, paid_amount, funding_channel_id, funding_channel_name_snapshot, purchase_channel_id, purchase_channel_name_snapshot, location_label_id, location_label_name_snapshot, note, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid, #{p.id}, 'EXPENSE', #{p.businessTime}, #{p.businessDate}, #{p.productId}, #{p.productName}, #{p.primaryId}, #{p.primaryName}, #{p.secondaryId}, #{p.secondaryName}, #{p.unitId}, #{p.unitName}, #{p.unitPrice}, #{p.quantity}, #{p.calculatedAmount}, #{p.paidAmount}, #{p.fundingId}, #{p.fundingName}, #{p.purchaseId}, #{p.purchaseName}, #{p.locationId}, #{p.locationName}, #{p.note}, #{p.now}, #{p.now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_time, business_date, product_id, product_name_snapshot, primary_category_id, primary_category_name_snapshot, secondary_category_id, secondary_category_name_snapshot, unit_id, unit_name_snapshot, unit_price, quantity, calculated_amount, paid_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(sum(a.amount),0) FROM expense_adjustment a WHERE a.original_expense_id=ledger_entry.id AND a.status='EFFECTIVE') AS effective_adjustment_amount, funding_channel_id, funding_channel_name_snapshot, purchase_channel_id, purchase_channel_name_snapshot, location_label_id, location_label_name_snapshot, note, created_at, updated_at, version FROM ledger_entry WHERE id = #{p.id} AND entry_type = 'EXPENSE' AND lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, business_time, business_date, product_id, product_name_snapshot, primary_category_id, primary_category_name_snapshot, secondary_category_id, secondary_category_name_snapshot, unit_id, unit_name_snapshot, unit_price, quantity, calculated_amount, paid_amount, 0::numeric AS effective_adjustment_amount, funding_channel_id, funding_channel_name_snapshot, purchase_channel_id, purchase_channel_name_snapshot, location_label_id, location_label_name_snapshot, note, created_at, updated_at, version FROM ledger_entry WHERE id = #{p.id} AND entry_type = 'EXPENSE' AND lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount),0) FROM expense_adjustment WHERE original_expense_id=#{p.id} AND status='EFFECTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE ledger_entry SET business_time=#{p.businessTime},business_date=#{p.businessDate}, product_id=#{p.productId},product_name_snapshot=#{p.productName}, primary_category_id=#{p.primaryId},primary_category_name_snapshot=#{p.primaryName}, secondary_category_id=#{p.secondaryId},secondary_category_name_snapshot=#{p.secondaryName}, unit_id=#{p.unitId},unit_name_snapshot=#{p.unitName},unit_price=#{p.unitPrice},quantity=#{p.quantity}, calculated_amount=#{p.calculatedAmount},paid_amount=#{p.paidAmount}, funding_channel_id=#{p.fundingId},funding_channel_name_snapshot=#{p.fundingName}, purchase_channel_id=#{p.purchaseId},purchase_channel_name_snapshot=#{p.purchaseName}, location_label_id=#{p.locationId},location_label_name_snapshot=#{p.locationName}, note=#{p.note},updated_at=#{p.now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{p.id} AND entry_type='EXPENSE' AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{p.version}
mapper.select: SELECT product_id FROM ledger_entry WHERE id = #{p.id} AND entry_type = 'EXPENSE' AND lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_record i WHERE i.operation = #{p.operation} AND i.idempotency_key = #{p.key} AND i.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND i.result_reference = #{p.result}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.id = #{p.id} AND l.entry_type = 'EXPENSE' AND l.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_adjustment a WHERE a.original_expense_id = l.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.source_record_id = l.id)
